name: QNAP Systems, Inc.
summary: QNAP Systems, Inc. engages in the manufacture and sale of data storage and processing equipment, wired communication machinery and optical instruments in Taiwan. The company offers storage products, such as network-attached storage, dual-controller, all-flash, thunderbolt, and multimedia NAS, expansion units, and cloud storage; networking, including managed switches, SD-WAN routers, NDR cybersecurity appliances, video conferencing system, network virtualization and uCPE; expansion accessories, such as cards and adaptors; and surveillance systems, including QVR surveillance system, and video surveillance system.
